title: Frontend Developer (React.js / Next.js)
description: We are looking for a passionate Frontend Developer with strong experience in React.js and Next.js to build fast, responsive, and user-friendly web applications. You will collaborate closely with designers, backend developers, and product teams to deliver scalable digital products while maintaining high standards of code quality, performance, and accessibility.
requirements: 2.5+ years of professional frontend development experience.
Strong knowledge of React.js and Next.js.
Experience integrating RESTful APIs.
Good understanding of responsive web design and cross-browser compatibility.
Knowledge of state management using Redux or Context API.
Familiarity with Git version control.
Ability to write clean, maintainable, and reusable code.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

title: Senior Frontend Developer
description: Join our frontend engineering team to develop modern, high-performance web applications using React.js and Next.js. You will lead UI implementation, optimize application performance, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and contribute to building exceptional digital experiences for our global clients.
requirements: 3+ years of experience in frontend development.
Hands-on expertise with React.js and Next.js.
Experience with Server-Side Rendering (SSR) and Static Site Generation (SSG).
Strong understanding of application performance optimization.
Knowledge of SEO best practices.
Experience with responsive and mobile-first design.
Excellent teamwork and communication skills.

title: Backend Developer (Node.js)
description: We are seeking an experienced Backend Developer with strong Node.js expertise to build secure, scalable, and high-performance backend systems. You will design APIs, optimize databases, integrate third-party services, and ensure reliable application performance for enterprise-grade solutions.
requirements: 3+ years of experience in Node.js development.
Strong understanding of JavaScript and asynchronous programming.
Experience designing RESTful APIs.
Knowledge of MongoDB or relational databases.
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Excellent debugging and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team environment.
